SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TANK_POWER_SOLO.title: Tank
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TANK_POWER_SOLO.descrip: Takes 50% more damage from enemies. Reflects all blocked Attack damage back at the attacker.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-PINCER_ATTACK_POWER_SOL: Takes double damage this turn from Attack cards that were not in hand when this was applied.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-STEALTH_POWER_SOLO.desc: Gains Block whenever damage is dealt by means other than an Attack card.
Whenever you play Sovereign Blade, replay every card that Forged this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GENEROUS_GIFT_POWER_SOL: At the start of your next turn, add a random Colorless card to your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONSTELLATION_POWER_SOL: At the start of your next turn, draw a card, gain Energy, and gain Block.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GLIMPSE_BEYOND_POWER_SO: At the start of your next {Amount} turns, add a Soul to your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-UNDERWORLD_POWER_SOLO.d: Whenever you apply Doom, deal damage equal to that amount.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CACOPHONY_POWER_SOLO.de: Every X cards drawn, deal damage to a random enemy.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-ENERGY_SURGE_POWER_SOLO: At the start of your next turns, gain Energy.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HIBERNATE_POWER_SOLO.de: Your Frost triggers its Passive twice this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-IMITATION_LEARNING_POWE: At the end of your next turns, play a copy of the last Power you played.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TAG_TEAM_POWER_SOLO.des: The next Attack you play on this enemy is played an extra time.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-KNOCKDOWN_POWER_SOLO.de: Starting next turn, takes double/triple damage for that turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BELIEVE_IN_YOU_POWER_SO: Once an Attack, a Skill, and a Power have all been played this turn, gain Energy.
At the start of your next turn, draw cards.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HELPING_HAND_POWER_SOLO: Doubles the Block gained from your next card.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BEACON_OF_HOPE_POWER_SO: At the end of your turn, banks half the Block you gained to grant at the start of your next turn.
